mutations.name: class no longer orders tasks inside a bet
kills: dispatch eligibility rules eligible tasks follow the owner's bet order, then product before upkeep, then oldest first

mutations.name: a selector freeze covers no task
kills: dispatch eligibility rules a freeze named by selector covers every task, so it fails closed

mutations.name: an empty owner_steps list is refused like an absent one
kills: dispatch eligibility rules absent owner_steps and an unset fold are refused, while an empty owner_steps list passes

mutations.name: a blank done_when passes
kills: dispatch eligibility rules a task without done_when, or with a blank one, is refused with no-done-when

mutations.name: any selected bet approves the task
kills: dispatch eligibility rules a task whose selected bet does not list it is refused with not-in-bet
